sentence: What amazed the child was not a new world, but the unnoticed music of the old.
translation: 让孩子惊奇的不是一个新世界，而是旧世界里未被注意的乐音。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句 | What amazed the child：what 引导主语从句（= The thing that amazed the child），谓语用单数 was | not... but... 并列表语：“不是……而是……”——否定与肯定的对举把重心推向 but 之后（课堂仿写：What surprises readers is not the characters in O. Henry's stories but the endings.）| the unnoticed music of the old：unnoticed 过去分词作定语“未被注意的”；the old 省略 world（承前省），旧世界与 a new world 对照 | 贝壳听海的寓言收束句——文学不造新世界，只唤醒旧世界之美，全文立意的第一次亮相
pattern: What + V-ed + sb + was not + A, but + B
imitationCn: 打动评委的不是华丽的技巧，而是歌声里未经修饰的真诚。
imitationHint: What moved the judges was not the fancy skills, → but the unpolished sincerity in the voice（not...but 对举）
imitationAnswer: What moved the judges was not the fancy skills, but the unpolished sincerity in the voice.

sentence: Some such experience as this lies in store for us when we begin the study of literature.
translation: 当我们开始学习文学时，某种如此这般的体验正等待着我们。
analysis: some such + 名词 + as this：“某种像这样的……”——such...as 关联结构（as 指代 this 所述的贝壳体验），词序注意 some such 而非 such some | lie in store for sb 等待着某人、即将降临（课堂强调：store 前无冠词——in store ≠ in a/the store 在商店里，高考易错）；同族：We never know what life holds in store for us. | when 时间状语从句 | 由寓言转入正题的枢纽句：把听贝壳的惊奇“预存”给文学学习——过渡句的示范
pattern: Some such + N + as this + lies in store for + sb + when ...
imitationCn: 当你翻开第一本原版小说时，某种如此这般的惊喜正等待着你。
imitationHint: Some such surprise as this lies in store for you → when you open your first novel in the original（in store 无冠词）
imitationAnswer: Some such surprise as this lies in store for you when you open your first novel in the original.

sentence: Let a little song appeal to the ear, or a great book to the heart, and we discover a new world, a world of dreams and magic.
translation: 让一支小曲打动耳朵，或让一部巨著触动心灵，我们便会发现一个新世界——一个充满梦想与魔力的世界。
analysis: 祈使句 + and + 陈述句：“只要……就……”（= If we let...）——祈使句表条件的经典句式 | or a great book to the heart：承前省略谓语 appeal（= or let a great book appeal to the heart），省略后 song/ear 与 book/heart 双双对仗：小曲入耳、巨著入心 | appeal to 吸引、打动（课堂 appeal 全网：appeal to sb 有吸引力、appeal to sb for sth 恳请、make an appeal 发出呼吁）| a world of dreams and magic：同位语复指 a new world 并展开——“逗号+同位语”的抒情加深 | 全文最诗意的句子，背诵级
pattern: Let + A + appeal to + N₁, or + B + to + N₂（省略）, and + S + V ..., 同位语
imitationCn: 让一次旅行打开眼界，或让一场对话打开心扉，我们便会遇见一个新的自己——一个更勇敢也更温柔的自己。
imitationHint: Let a journey open the eyes, or a conversation the heart（省略 open）, and we meet a new self, → a self braver and gentler
imitationAnswer: Let a journey open the eyes, or a conversation the heart, and we meet a new self, a self braver and gentler.

sentence: Some truth and beauty remain unnoticed until a sensitive human soul brings them to our attention, just as the shell reflects the unnoticed sounds.
translation: 一些真与美一直不为人注意，直到一个敏锐的心灵让它们引起我们的注意，正如贝壳映出那些未被听见的声音一样。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句（三层结构）| 主句 Some truth and beauty remain unnoticed：remain + 过去分词作表语（保持“未被注意”状态）| until 引导时间状语从句：bring sth to one's attention 使……受到注意 | just as 引导方式状语从句“正如……”——用贝壳寓言回环呼应开篇，议论文的类比论证（analogy）| a sensitive human soul“敏锐的心灵”即作家诗人——文学家的定义藏在从句里 | 课堂仿写示范：The deep meanings of some works remain unexplored until the readers reach a certain age, just as the season brings out the flavor of fruit.
pattern: S + remain + V-ed + until + 从句, just as + 从句（类比）
imitationCn: 一些作品的深意一直无人发掘，直到读者到了相应的年龄，正如果实要到相应的季节才显出风味。
imitationHint: The deep meanings of some works remain unexplored until the readers reach a certain age, → just as the season brings out the flavor of fruit（课堂仿写原题）
imitationAnswer: The deep meanings of some works remain unexplored until the readers reach a certain age, just as the season brings out the flavor of fruit.

sentence: One who reads it is capable of seeing the beauty that was hidden from his eyes before.
translation: 读它的人便能看到从前对他的双眼隐藏着的美。
analysis: One who...：不定代词 one 作先行词 + who 定语从句——“凡读它的人”，比 people who 更庄重的泛指 | be capable of doing 有能力做（课堂拓展：capable/incapable、capability；辨析 be able to do 接不定式、capable 接 of doing）| the beauty that was hidden from his eyes：that 定语从句 + 被动语态，hide sth from sb 对某人隐藏——“美一直都在，只是被藏着”，与上句 remain unnoticed 一脉相承 | before 句末副词轻轻一收：读诗前后，判若两人——文学改变感知的证词
pattern: One who + V + is capable of + V-ing + the N + that was + V-ed + from ...
imitationCn: 学过摄影的人便能捕捉到从前从他眼前溜走的光影。
imitationHint: One who has learned photography is capable of catching → the light and shadow that escaped his eyes before
imitationAnswer: One who has learned photography is capable of catching the light and shadow that escaped his eyes before.

sentence: Its attraction lies more in what it awakens in us than what it says.
translation: 文学的魅力更多在于它在我们心中唤醒了什么，而非它说了什么。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句 | lie in 在于（抽象“位于”）| more... than... 比较结构横跨两个 what 宾语从句：what it awakens in us / what it says——比较的不是数量而是“分量” | awaken sth in sb 在某人心中唤醒某物（awaken-awakened；比 wake up 更文学化）| 短句浓缩全文文论核心：文学作品的价值在读者的共鸣里，不在文字本身——接受美学的一句话版本 | 课堂仿写示范：The beauty of poetry lies more in what it inspires in us than what it describes. 此句型是文艺评论/读后感的万能骨架
pattern: S + lies more in + what-从句 + than + what-从句
imitationCn: 诗歌的美不仅在于它描绘的画面，更多地在于它给予人的启发。
imitationHint: The beauty of poetry lies more in what it inspires in us → than what it describes（课堂仿写原题）
imitationAnswer: The beauty of poetry lies more in what it inspires in us than what it describes.

sentence: To achieve this, it should contain two elements: universal interest and personal style.
translation: 要做到这一点，它应当包含两个要素：普遍的趣味与个人的风格。
analysis: To achieve this 目的状语不定式前置（this 回指上文“成为文学”）| contain 包含（课堂辨析：contain 指内部含有、无被动无进行；include 指把……列为一部分，including/included 作状语）| 冒号后列举两要素，universal（普遍/大众）与 personal（个人/独特）语义相对——文学的双重悖论一冒号道尽 | two elements 先总数后展开：“数字预告+冒号点名”的列举话术，学术写作高频 | element 要素、成分
pattern: To achieve this, S + should contain + two elements: + A and B（对立并列）
imitationCn: 要写好读后续写，文章应当兼顾两个要素：情节的合理与语言的出彩。
imitationHint: To write a good continuation, it should contain two elements: → logical plot and brilliant language（冒号列举）
imitationAnswer: To write a good continuation, it should contain two elements: logical plot and brilliant language.

sentence: In summary, literature is the expression of life in forms of truth and beauty, the written record of man's thoughts and feelings, and the history of the human soul.
translation: 总之，文学是以真和美的形式对生命的表达，是人类思想和感悟的文字记录，是人类灵魂的历史。
analysis: In summary 总结衔接语（= to sum up / in conclusion）标记全文收束 | 三重表语排比：the expression of... / the written record of... / the history of...——同一主语连下三个定义，视角层层拔高：生命的表达（内容）→ 思想的记录（载体）→ 灵魂的历史（高度），最后一个短语最短却最重 | in forms of truth and beauty 以真与美的形式（呼应上文 truth and beauty）| 定义式收尾金句：A is X, Y, and Z 的三段式排比可整体迁移到任何“……是什么”的议论文结尾 | 全文背诵级的终句
pattern: In summary, S + is + the N₁ of ..., the N₂ of ..., and the N₃ of ...（三重表语排比）
imitationCn: 总之，母校是青春岁月的见证，是良师益友的相遇之地，是我们精神的故乡。
imitationHint: In summary, our alma mater is the witness of our youth, the meeting place of good teachers and friends, → and the homeland of our spirit（三重表语）
imitationAnswer: In summary, our alma mater is the witness of our youth, the meeting place of good teachers and friends, and the homeland of our spirit.

sentence: A man can be destroyed but not defeated.
translation: 一个人可以被毁灭，但不能被打败。
analysis: 《老人与海》的灵魂句 | 情态动词被动语态 can be destroyed + 承前省略的并列：but not defeated（= but cannot be defeated）——省略让两个过去分词 destroyed/defeated 直接对撞 | destroy 毁灭（肉体/物质层面，课堂辨析：destroy 彻底毁坏不能修复 / damage 局部损坏 / ruin 糟蹋）vs defeat 打败（意志/精神层面，辨析 defeat/beat 接对手、win 接比赛）——两个动词的选择本身就是主题：肉体可灭，精神不屈 | 七词格言：短句+对仗+头韵（destroyed/defeated 均 d 开头）成就文学史上最有力的硬汉宣言
pattern: S + can be + V-ed + but not + V-ed（省略并列）
imitationCn: 梦想可以被推迟，但不能被放弃。
imitationHint: A dream can be delayed → but not abandoned（省略 cannot be，两个过去分词对撞）
imitationAnswer: A dream can be delayed but not abandoned.

sentence: After coming in empty-handed for eighty-four days, Santiago attempts to catch a huge fish.
translation: 空手而归八十四天之后，圣地亚哥试图捕捉一条大鱼。
analysis: After + 动名词短语作时间状语（= After he has come in...）——介词后接 V-ing 的压缩句式 | empty-handed 复合形容词“空手的”作主语补足语（come in empty-handed 空手归来；同族 bare-footed/broken-hearted/absent-minded）| for eighty-four days 持续时间——数字的分量：84 天的失败垫在一次尝试之前，简介开篇即给出人物的悲壮底色 | attempt to do 尝试做（课堂辨析：attempt 正式、常暗示未必成功；try 通俗；manage to do 成功做成）| 剧情简介用一般现在时（历史现在时）
pattern: After + V-ing + 补足语 + for + 时间, S + attempts to + V
imitationCn: 连续三次落选之后，她再次尝试竞选学生会主席。
imitationHint: After losing three times in a row, she attempts → to run for chair of the students' union again（attempt to do）
imitationAnswer: After losing three times in a row, she attempts to run for chair of the students' union again.

sentence: The fish was coming in on his circle now calm and beautiful looking and only his great tail moving.
translation: 这条鱼正打着转靠近，显得平静而美丽，只有巨大的尾巴在摆动。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句（海明威电报体范本）| calm and beautiful looking：形容词短语作伴随状语，描摹鱼靠近时的状态 | and only his great tail moving：独立主格结构（逻辑主语 his great tail + 现在分词 moving，= and only his great tail was moving 的省略）——巨大身躯静止、唯尾鳍在动，一静一动的电影镜头 | 全句无逗号的连续 and 串联（polysyndeton）是海明威标志文风：不加评论、只列事实 | 与必修二 U3 的 all dressed up / their minds full of 组成独立主格三连击——三种宾补形态（过去分词/形容词/现在分词）正好集齐
pattern: S + was + V-ing ... + adj.短语 + and only + N + V-ing（独立主格）
imitationCn: 台风正沿海岸逼近，天色阴沉而安静，只有旗帜在猎猎作响。
imitationHint: The typhoon was moving in along the coast, dark and quiet looking, → and only the flags flapping（独立主格：名词+现在分词）
imitationAnswer: The typhoon was moving in along the coast, dark and quiet looking, and only the flags flapping.

sentence: But when he put all of his effort on, starting it well out before the fish came alongside and pulling with all his strength, the fish pulled part way over and then righted himself and swam away.
translation: 可是当他使出浑身力气——在鱼靠近之前早早发力、拼尽全力拉线时，那鱼只翻转了一半，随即正回身子游走了。
analysis: 长句动作链的教科书 | when 从句内嵌两个现在分词短语 starting... and pulling... 作伴随状语，把“发力”拆成两个连贯动作；before 从句再嵌一层（鱼靠近之前）| 主句三连谓语 pulled... righted... and swam away：动作接动作、不加修饰——人与鱼的角力全程用动词推进，读后续写动作描写的黄金范本 | part way 副词“部分地、半途”（part way over 翻到一半）| right v. 使回正（right oneself 正回身子——熟词僻义！）| alongside 到旁边 | with all one's strength 用尽全力
pattern: When + S + V, V-ing₁ ... and V-ing₂ ..., S + V₁ ... and then + V₂ and + V₃
imitationCn: 可当她拼尽全力冲刺——提前变速、摆臂到极限时，对手只慢了半步，随即稳住脚步反超了过去。
imitationHint: When she gave it everything, speeding up early and swinging her arms to the limit, → her rival fell half a step behind, then steadied herself and pulled ahead（三连谓语）
imitationAnswer: When she gave it everything, speeding up early and swinging her arms to the limit, her rival fell half a step behind, then steadied herself and pulled ahead.

sentence: Now you are getting confused in the head, he thought.
translation: “现在你脑子开始犯糊涂了，”他想。
analysis: 内心独白的自由直接引语：引语在前、he thought 后置——不用引号也能进入人物内心（海明威原文即无引号），读后续写心理描写的高级形态 | 人称的妙处：老人用 you 称呼自己（自我对话），孤独感与自我警醒同时到位 | get + confused：get 系动词表变化“开始变得”，进行时 are getting 强调“正在发生的渐变” | confused 课堂全家桶：confused（人）困惑的 / confusing（物）令人困惑的 / confuse A with B 混淆 / in confusion 困惑地 | in the head 在头脑里（口语）
pattern: 引语（第二人称自语）, + he thought.（独白后置）
imitationCn: “现在你开始慌了，”她对自己想，随即深吸一口气。
imitationHint: Now you are getting nervous, she thought to herself, → then took a deep breath（独白后置 + 第二人称自语）
imitationAnswer: Now you are getting nervous, she thought to herself, then took a deep breath.

sentence: Take time to look through the collections in different sections of your local library, and you are likely to come across books you love to read.
translation: 花点时间浏览本地图书馆不同区域的藏书，你就很可能邂逅自己爱读的书。
analysis: 祈使句 + and + 陈述句：“只要……就……”（与本单元 Let... and we discover 同款条件式祈使，双例互证）| take time to do 花时间（从容地）做 | look through 浏览、翻阅（look 短语群）| be likely to do 很可能（人作主语）| come across 偶然遇到、邂逅（= run into；“遇见好书”用 come across 自带惊喜感）| books (that) you love to read 省略 that 的定语从句 | collection 藏书/收藏品（课堂多义：作品集、募捐、收取）；section 区域、部门
pattern: 祈使句 ..., and + S + are likely to come across + N + (that)定语从句
imitationCn: 花点时间和不同班级的同学聊聊，你就很可能遇到志同道合的朋友。
imitationHint: Take time to chat with students from different classes, → and you are likely to come across friends who share your interests
imitationAnswer: Take time to chat with students from different classes, and you are likely to come across friends who share your interests.
